title: Combinatorial covering properties in an uncountable setting: canonical examples
summary: We provide examples of spaces satisfying generalized combinatorial covering properties such as the Hurewicz, Menger, and $γ$-properties in an uncountable setting. Our approach is motivated by canonical constructions from the classical countable case, including the examples of Bartoszyński and Shelah separating the Hurewicz property from $σ$-compactness, the examples of Tsaban and Zdomskyy separating the Hurewicz and Menger properties, and Tsaban's construction of a nontrivial set of reals with the $γ$-property.
